english.title: Fail to produce tachograph recording equipment record sheet / record sheets
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to comply with a requirement made by an officer under section 99(1) of the Transport Act 1968 in that you did not produce

(A)_[a record sheet]_
(B)_[record sheets]_

which you were required by articles 27 to 29 and 32 to 37 of the EU Tachographs Regulation to be able to produce
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(1)(a)(iii) of the Transport Act 1968.
